async def act(page):
    # Plan:
    # 1) Navigate to the order view for order #299 using a relative URL from the current dashboard.
    # 2) Find the Shipping Address section and click its Edit control (using accessibility-tree selectors).
    # 3) Fill the shipping address fields (street, city, postcode, region/state, country) using get_by_role/get_by_label.
    # 4) Click the Save/Update control (final action) to persist changes.

    # Reasoning about knowledge base functions: there are no helper functions provided in the knowledge base to call,
    # so all interactions will be implemented directly with Playwright accessibility selectors.

    # 1) Navigate to the order view page for order #299
    await page.goto('../sales_order/view/order_id/299/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')

    # Short helpers using only accessibility-tree-centric selectors (get_by_role / get_by_label / get_by_text)
    async def click_edit_in_address_section():
        # Try to locate a group that contains the text "Shipping Address" and click an Edit link/button inside it.
        try:
            addr_group = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Shipping Address"))
            if await addr_group.count() > 0:
                edit_link = addr_group.get_by_role("link", name="Edit")
                if await edit_link.count() > 0:
                    await edit_link.first.click()
                    return True
                edit_button = addr_group.get_by_role("button", name="Edit")
                if await edit_button.count() > 0:
                    await edit_button.first.click()
                    return True
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Fallback: find any Edit link/button that has the text "Shipping Address" nearby
        try:
            edit_link2 = page.get_by_role("link", name="Edit").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Shipping Address"))
            if await edit_link2.count() > 0:
                await edit_link2.first.click()
                return True
            edit_button2 = page.get_by_role("button", name="Edit").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Shipping Address"))
            if await edit_button2.count() > 0:
                await edit_button2.first.click()
                return True
        except Exception:
            pass

        return False

    async def try_fill_textbox_labels(labels, value):
        # Try to fill by accessible textbox role first
        for lbl in labels:
            try:
                tb = page.get_by_role("textbox", name=lbl)
                if await tb.count() > 0:
                    # If there are multiple textboxes for the same name (e.g., street lines), fill the first
                    await tb.first.fill(value)
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass
        # Fallback: try get_by_label (labels sometimes are available via get_by_label)
        for lbl in labels:
            try:
                lb = page.get_by_label(lbl)
                if await lb.count() > 0:
                    await lb.first.fill(value)
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass
        return False

    async def try_select_combobox_labels(labels, label_to_select, value_fallback=None):
        # Try to find combobox (select) elements by accessible name and select by visible label first,
        # then try fallback value if provided.
        for lbl in labels:
            try:
                cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=lbl)
                if await cb.count() > 0:
                    try:
                        await cb.first.select_option(label=label_to_select)
                    except Exception:
                        if value_fallback is not None:
                            await cb.first.select_option(value=value_fallback)
                    return True
            except Exception:
                pass
        return False

    # 2) Click Edit for Shipping Address
    edited = await click_edit_in_address_section()
    # Wait briefly for the edit controls/form to appear if we clicked Edit
    if edited:
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)

    # 3) Fill address fields
    street_value = "456 Oak Avenue, Apartment 5B"
    city_value = "New York"
    postcode_value = "10001"
    region_label = "New York"
    region_value_code = "NY"
    country_label = "United States"
    country_code = "US"

    # Street: try several common label names (Magento sometimes has multiple street lines)
    street_labels = ["Street Address", "Street", "Address", "Shipping Street", "Street 1"]
    await try_fill_textbox_labels(street_labels, street_value)

    # City
    city_labels = ["City", "Shipping City", "City/Town"]
    await try_fill_textbox_labels(city_labels, city_value)

    # Postcode / ZIP
    postcode_labels = ["ZIP/Postal Code", "Postcode", "Zip / Postal Code", "ZIP", "Postal Code"]
    await try_fill_textbox_labels(postcode_labels, postcode_value)

    # Region / State - try combobox names commonly used in Magento admin
    region_combobox_labels = ["State/Province", "Region", "Region/State", "State"]
    await try_select_combobox_labels(region_combobox_labels, region_label, region_value_code)

    # Country
    country_combobox_labels = ["Country", "Country/Region", "Country/Region"]
    await try_select_combobox_labels(country_combobox_labels, country_label, country_code)

    # 4) Save changes - prefer Save button inside the address section, otherwise Save Order as fallback.
    # Try to click a Save/Update control residing in the same Shipping Address group (if present)
    try:
        addr_group_after = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Shipping Address"))
        if await addr_group_after.count() > 0:
            # Try typical button/link names
            for name in ["Save Address", "Save", "Update", "Submit"]:
                btn = addr_group_after.get_by_role("button", name=name)
                if await btn.count() > 0:
                    await btn.first.click()
                    return
                lnk = addr_group_after.get_by_role("link", name=name)
                if await lnk.count() > 0:
                    await lnk.first.click()
                    return
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Fallback: try a global Save Order control (this may navigate away; make it the last action)
    for name in ["Save Order", "Save", "Update Order", "Update"]:
        try:
            btn_global = page.get_by_role("button", name=name)
            if await btn_global.count() > 0:
                await btn_global.first.click()
                return
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            lnk_global = page.get_by_role("link", name=name)
            if await lnk_global.count() > 0:
                await lnk_global.first.click()
                return
        except Exception:
            pass

    # If we reach here, we couldn't find a save control — raise an error so the test harness knows.
    raise Exception("Unable to find address edit/save controls for order #299 on the page.")
